about: Where the ground the generator still holds meets the master's (height-grid Stage 1, tools/ground_bake.py from tools/_ground_faces_dump.gd's dump). holes: each held body with open edges, its open edges chained, every corner its dumped float32 value, Godot world metres (x east, y up, z south); a closed chain's last corner joins its first; together the chains are the body's open edges exactly, each once. master_meets_m: how much of the master's own open edge runs along the body's (midpoint within edge_tolerance_m). meets: the master's open edges lying on a held solid (CSG, closed, so no open edges of its own), two corners each, the master's values.

source.what: The faces the generator measures the ground from, as Godot loads them, for the height grid's bake.
source.layout: raw little-endian float32; faces three corners each, open edges two; a corner is (x, y, z), Godot world metres, y up, x east, z south
